summary: Sadot Group Inc. filed Form 8-K disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq compliance letter on August 3, 2026. The company had previously failed the $2.5 million stockholders' equity requirement (Rule 5550(b)(1)) and alternatives, submitted a plan, and reported pro forma equity. Nasdaq now confirms compliance but warns delisting risk if not evidenced at September 30, 2026 filing, with appeal rights. No impact on trading currently. Watch for periodic report compliance and potential delisting.
